questions.question: Which statement best describes Locally redundant storage (LRS)?

options.text: A Blob Storage tier optimized for infrequently accessed data generally stored for at least 90 days
GZRS with read access to the secondary-region copy before failover

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure storage redundancy
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Geo-redundant storage (GRS): the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.
Locally redundant storage (LRS): replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region.
Zone-redundant storage (ZRS): synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.
Zone-redundant storage (ZRS): the point in time to which data can be recovered, reflecting possible lag in asynchronous replication.
Locally redundant storage (LRS): ZRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a secondary region.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Locally redundant storage (LRS) — replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region; and Zone-redundant storage (ZRS) — synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.

questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: Geo-redundant storage (GRS): LRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a paired secondary region.
Geo-zone-redundant storage (GZRS): ZRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a secondary region.
Geo-redundant storage (GRS): GZRS with read access to the secondary-region copy before failover.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Geo-redundant storage (GRS) — LRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a paired secondary region; and Geo-zone-redundant storage (GZRS) — ZRS in the primary region plus asynchronous replication to LRS in a secondary region.
